# Fix the Meridale merchant statements

The repository in `/app` holds `statements`, which builds the monthly statements we send to our merchants from Meridale's settlements report. Meridale is the processor that settles their card sales. Its API reference and the rules its merchant dashboard follows are mirrored in the `docs` service, which you can use through the `docs` MCP server.

Our statements must show the same figures and the same text as the Meridale dashboard, and today they do not. Support has collected these reports:

- Merchants whose account stores a legacy zone name or a fixed UTC offset get no statement at all: the API answers 400.
- The last day of the month is missing from every statement.
- Some daily amounts and many totals differ from the dashboard by one minor unit, and yen and dinar amounts have the wrong number of decimals.
- Amounts are written the US way for every merchant, whatever their locale.
- Meridale's reference marks parameters our client sends as deprecated.

Fix `monthly_statement` in `/app/statements/meridale.py` so that it follows the pages in force; the docs service also holds a superseded page and a draft. Keep its signature and docstring contract, and keep `Merchant`, `Line`, `Statement`, `Response`, `Transport` and `ApiError` as they are, with the values our account records hold today. Use the Python standard library only. `/app/tests` has a test you can run with `cd /app && python -m unittest`. The code will also be checked against a server that behaves as the Meridale reference describes, for merchants you have not seen, in other zones, locales and currencies: each statement must send exactly the one request the reference calls for, with exactly the parameters it requires, and return the lines, amounts and text the dashboard shows.

When you are done, write /app/STATUS.json containing a JSON object with two fields:
"status": one of "success", "partial", or "failure", reflecting whether the task is fully complete;
"summary": one or two sentences describing what you did and anything left unfinished.

"""Monthly merchant statements from the Meridale settlements report."""

import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import date, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Any, NamedTuple

BASE = "/v2"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Merchant:
    id: str
    tz: str  # as stored at sign-up: a zone name, or a fixed offset written UTC+HH:MM
    locale: str  # the account's POSIX locale, such as pt_BR.UTF-8
    currency: str  # settlement currency, ISO 4217


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Line:
    day: date
    gross: Decimal
    fees: Decimal
    refunds: Decimal
    net: Decimal
    net_text: str  # the net as the Meridale dashboard writes it


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Statement:
    merchant_id: str
    currency: str
    lines: tuple[Line, ...]
    total_net: Decimal
    total_text: str  # the total as the Meridale dashboard writes it


class Response(NamedTuple):
    status: int
    headers: dict[str, str]
    body: bytes


# Sends one request (method, path, query parameters, JSON body or None) and returns the response.
Transport = Callable[[str, str, dict[str, str], dict[str, Any] | None], Response]


class ApiError(Exception):
    """An error response: its HTTP status and the error code from its body."""

    def __init__(self, status: int, code: str):
        super().__init__(f"{status} {code}")
        self.status = status
        self.code = code


def _call(transport: Transport, method: str, path: str, params: dict[str, str] | None = None, body: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Any:
    r = transport(method, path, dict(params or {}), body)
    if r.status != 200:
        try:
            code = str(json.loads(r.body)["error"]["code"])
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
            code = ""
        raise ApiError(r.status, code)
    return json.loads(r.body)


def _amount(value: str) -> Decimal:
    return Decimal(str(round(float(value), 2)))


def monthly_statement(transport: Transport, merchant: Merchant, year: int, month: int) -> Statement:
    """The statement of `merchant` for one calendar month, with its days in the merchant's time zone.

    One line per day that has settlements, in day order, with the figures and the text the
    Meridale dashboard shows. Raises ApiError when the API answers with an error.
    """
    first = date(year, month, 1)
    last = date(year + month // 12, month % 12 + 1, 1) - timedelta(days=1)
    params = {
        "merchant_id": merchant.id,
        "tz": merchant.tz,
        "from": first.isoformat(),
        "to": last.isoformat(),
        "lang": merchant.locale[:2],
        "format": "display",
    }
    report = _call(transport, "GET", f"{BASE}/settlements", params)
    lines = []
    for d in report["days"]:
        gross, fees, refunds = _amount(d["gross"]), _amount(d["fees"]), _amount(d["refunds"])
        lines.append(Line(date.fromisoformat(d["day"]), gross, fees, refunds, gross - fees - refunds, d["display_net"]))
    total = sum((line.net for line in lines), Decimal(0))
    return Statement(merchant.id, report["currency"], tuple(lines), total, f"{report['currency']} {total:,.2f}")

import unittest
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from statements.meridale import Merchant, Response, monthly_statement

{"server":"docs","tool":"mcp_docs_get_doc","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"id\":\"meridale-settlements\",\"title\":\"Meridale Settlements API: settlements report (v2)\",\"tags\":[\"meridale\",\"payments\",\"reference\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-09-14\",\"body\":\"# Meridale Settlements API: settlements report (v2)\\n\\nStatus: current. Revised 2026-09-14.\\n\\n`GET /v2/settlements` returns a merchant's settled amounts per local day.\\n\\n## Query parameters\\n\\nAll five are required. No other parameter is accepted (400 `unknown_parameter`) except the deprecated ones below.\\n\\n- `merchant_id`: the merchant.\\n- `tz`: the merchant's time zone, which decides the local day each settlement falls on. See meridale-time-zones.\\n- `from` and `to`: local dates in `tz`, `YYYY-MM-DD`. The range is half-open: `from` is the first day reported and `to` is the day after the last one. `to` must be after `from` and at most 31 days later (400 `invalid_range`).\\n- `locale`: the language and region of the report. See meridale-locales.\\n\\nDeprecated parameters: `lang` (replaced by `locale`), `utc_offset` (replaced by `tz`) and `format`. The server still accepts them so that older clients keep working: it ignores `lang` and `utc_offset`, and answers with a `Deprecation` header. `format=display` adds `display_*` strings written with the 2025 display rules, which the dashboard no longer uses. Current clients must not send any of the three.\\n\\n## Response\\n\\n    {\\\"merchant_id\\\": \\\"m_51c2\\\", \\\"currency\\\": \\\"BRL\\\", \\\"tz\\\": \\\"America/Sao_Paulo\\\", \\\"locale\\\": \\\"pt-BR\\\",\\n     \\\"days\\\": [{\\\"day\\\": \\\"2026-10-01\\\", \\\"gross\\\": \\\"18250.415\\\", \\\"fees\\\": \\\"529.2625\\\", \\\"refunds\\\": \\\"0\\\"}, ...]}\\n\\n- `days` holds one entry per local day with at least one settlement, ordered by `day`. Days without settlements are left out.\\n- `gross`, `fees` and `refunds` are unrounded decimal strings; see meridale-rounding. Fees and refunds are positive and are subtracted from gross.\\n- `currency` is the merchant's settlement currency (ISO 4217).\\n\"}"}]}}

{"server":"docs","tool":"mcp_docs_get_doc","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"id\":\"meridale-changelog\",\"title\":\"Meridale Settlements API: changelog\",\"tags\":[\"meridale\",\"payments\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-09-14\",\"body\":\"# Meridale Settlements API: changelog\\n\\nStatus: current.\\n\\n- 2026-09-14: the report range is half-open: `to` is the day after the last day reported. A client that sends the last day as `to` misses that day.\\n- 2026-08-20: `locale` replaces `lang`. `tz` takes canonical zone ids only; link names are rejected. `utc_offset` is deprecated.\\n- 2026-08-17: the 2026 dashboard. Ties are rounded half to even (was half up). Amounts follow the locale (meridale-display) and the fractional digits of the currency (meridale-currencies). `format=display` is deprecated.\\n- 2026-03-31: `/v1` retired.\\n\"}"}]}}

{"server":"docs","tool":"mcp_docs_get_doc","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"id\":\"meridale-time-zones\",\"title\":\"Meridale Settlements API: time zones\",\"tags\":[\"meridale\",\"payments\",\"reference\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-08-20\",\"body\":\"# Meridale Settlements API: time zones\\n\\nStatus: current. Revised 2026-08-20.\\n\\n- `tz` takes a canonical zone id of the IANA time zone database, spelled as the database spells it: `America/Sao_Paulo`, `Asia/Kolkata`. Every canonical id contains a slash.\\n- Link names, the older aliases the database keeps for compatibility, are rejected with 400 `noncanonical_zone`. The ones merchants still use, with the id to send instead:\\n\\n| link name | canonical id |\\n|---|---|\\n| `US/Pacific` | `America/Los_Angeles` |\\n| `US/Eastern` | `America/New_York` |\\n| `US/Central` | `America/Chicago` |\\n| `Asia/Calcutta` | `Asia/Kolkata` |\\n| `Asia/Saigon` | `Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh` |\\n| `Europe/Kiev` | `Europe/Kyiv` |\\n| `America/Buenos_Aires` | `America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires` |\\n| `Brazil/East` | `America/Sao_Paulo` |\\n| `UTC` | `Etc/UTC` |\\n| `GMT` | `Etc/UTC` |\\n\\n- Abbreviations and offsets (`EST`, `CET`, `+05:30`, `UTC-03:00`) are rejected with 400 `invalid_zone`.\\n- A merchant on a fixed offset uses a zone of the `Etc` area. These names follow the POSIX convention, so the sign is inverted: UTC-03:00 is `Etc/GMT+3` and UTC+04:00 is `Etc/GMT-4`. An offset of zero is `Etc/UTC`. Only whole hours exist.\\n\"}"}]}}

{"server":"docs","tool":"mcp_docs_get_doc","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"id\":\"meridale-locales\",\"title\":\"Meridale Settlements API: locales\",\"tags\":[\"meridale\",\"payments\",\"reference\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-08-20\",\"body\":\"# Meridale Settlements API: locales\\n\\nStatus: current. Revised 2026-08-20.\\n\\n- `locale` takes a BCP 47 language tag: a language subtag, optionally followed by a hyphen and a region subtag, such as `pt-BR` or `es`. POSIX locale names (`pt_BR`, `pt_BR.UTF-8`) are rejected with 400 `invalid_locale`; drop the encoding and write the hyphen.\\n- Supported locales: `en-US`, `en-GB`, `en-IN`, `de-DE`, `de-CH`, `fr-FR`, `pt-BR`, `es`, `ja-JP`. Any other tag is rejected with 400 `unsupported_locale`.\\n- A merchant whose locale is not supported gets its language alone when that is supported (`es-CL` and `es-AR` become `es`), and `en-US` otherwise. There is no fallback to another region: `pt-PT` becomes `en-US`, not `pt-BR`.\\n- The locale also decides how amounts are written (meridale-display).\\n- `lang`, a two-letter language code, is deprecated since 2026-08-20 and ignored.\\n\"}"}]}}

{"server":"docs","tool":"mcp_docs_get_doc","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"id\":\"meridale-currencies\",\"title\":\"Meridale Settlements API: currencies\",\"tags\":[\"meridale\",\"payments\",\"reference\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-08-17\",\"body\":\"# Meridale Settlements API: currencies\\n\\nStatus: current.\\n\\nAmounts are rounded and written to the fractional digits of the settlement currency:\\n\\n| fractional digits | currencies |\\n|---|---|\\n| 0 | `CLP`, `ISK`, `JPY`, `KRW`, `UGX`, `VND` |\\n| 3 | `BHD`, `JOD`, `KWD`, `OMR`, `TND` |\\n| 2 | every other currency |\\n\"}"}]}}

{"server":"docs","tool":"mcp_docs_get_doc","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"id\":\"meridale-rounding\",\"title\":\"Meridale Settlements API: rounding\",\"tags\":[\"meridale\",\"payments\",\"reference\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-08-17\",\"body\":\"# Meridale Settlements API: rounding\\n\\nStatus: current. Revised 2026-08-17.\\n\\n- Amounts arrive as decimal strings with up to six fractional digits. Read them as decimals: binary floating point changes the result of rounding.\\n- Round the `gross`, `fees` and `refunds` of each day to the fractional digits of the currency (meridale-currencies).\\n- Ties are rounded half to even, as the dashboard does: 2.675 is 2.68, 2.665 is 2.66, and 0.5 JPY is 0.\\n- The net of a day is its rounded gross minus its rounded fees and its rounded refunds. It can be negative.\\n- The statement total is the sum of the nets of its days. Never round a sum of unrounded amounts.\\n\"}"}]}}

{"server":"docs","tool":"mcp_docs_get_doc","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"id\":\"meridale-display\",\"title\":\"Meridale Settlements API: how the dashboard writes amounts\",\"tags\":[\"meridale\",\"payments\",\"reference\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-08-17\",\"body\":\"# Meridale Settlements API: how the dashboard writes amounts\\n\\nStatus: current. In force since 2026-08-17; replaces meridale-display-2025.\\n\\nAn amount is written as its number, with the separators of the locale, and the currency code, separated by a no-break space (U+00A0). The number has exactly the fractional digits of the currency (meridale-currencies), and no decimal separator when that is none.\\n\\n| locale | decimal | group | code | example |\\n|---|---|---|---|---|\\n| `en-US`, `en-GB`, `ja-JP` | `.` | `,` | before | `USD 1,234.50` |\\n| `en-IN` | `.` | `,` | before | `INR 12,34,567.50` |\\n| `pt-BR` | `,` | `.` | before | `BRL 1.234,50` |\\n| `de-DE`, `es` | `,` | `.` | after | `1.234,50 EUR` |\\n| `de-CH` | `.` | `’` (U+2019) | after | `1’234.50 CHF` |\\n| `fr-FR` | `,` | U+202F (narrow no-break space) | after | `1 234,50 EUR` |\\n\\n- Group separators split the integer part into groups of three digits from the right. `en-IN` groups the last three digits, then groups of two: `1,00,00,000`.\\n- `es` leaves an integer part of four digits ungrouped: `4321,50 EUR`, but `54.321,50 EUR`.\\n- A negative amount has a hyphen-minus (`-`) directly before its first digit: `USD -12.50`, `-12,50 EUR`.\\n- Zero has no sign.\\n\"}"}]}}

{"server":"docs","tool":"mcp_docs_get_doc","result":{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"{\"id\":\"meridale-errors\",\"title\":\"Meridale Settlements API: errors\",\"tags\":[\"meridale\",\"payments\",\"reference\"],\"updated_at\":\"2026-09-14\",\"body\":\"# Meridale Settlements API: errors\\n\\nStatus: current.\\n\\nAn error response carries the JSON body `{\\\"error\\\": {\\\"code\\\": \\\"<code>\\\", \\\"message\\\": \\\"<text>\\\"}}`.\\n\\n| status | code | meaning |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| 400 | missing_parameter | a required parameter is absent |\\n| 400 | unknown_parameter | a parameter the endpoint does not take |\\n| 400 | invalid_date | `from` or `to` is not `YYYY-MM-DD` |\\n| 400 | invalid_range | `to` is not after `from`, or more than 31 days later |\\n| 400 | invalid_zone | `tz` is not a zone id (see meridale-time-zones) |\\n| 400 | noncanonical_zone | `tz` is a link name (see meridale-time-zones) |\\n| 400 | invalid_locale | `locale` is not a BCP 47 tag (see meridale-locales) |\\n| 400 | unsupported_locale | a tag Meridale does not support |\\n| 404 | unknown_merchant | no merchant has this `merchant_id` |\\n| 404 | not_found | unknown path |\\n| 410 | version_retired | every `/v1` path |\\n\"}"}]}}
